data.name: Usage
data.value:
winqemu — drives WinQEMU's virtual machines from a terminal (WinQEMU is started in the notification area if needed).
Usage: winqemu <command> [arguments]
list [--folder <folder>] [--json] Lists the machines, their state and folder. status <machine> Shows a machine's state. start <machine> [--wait] [--password-stdin] Starts a machine; --wait waits until it runs. An encrypted machine's password is read from the standard input, or asked for, unless remembered. stop <machine> [--wait] [--timeout <seconds>] Asks the guest to shut down (power button). poweroff <machine> Turns the machine off at once, like pulling the plug. pause <machine> | resume <machine> Pauses or resumes a running machine. start --folder <folder> Starts the folder's machines, subfolders included, each after its automatic start delay. An encrypted one needs a remembered password. stop --folder <folder> Asks the folder's running machines to shut down. pause --folder <folder> | resume --folder <folder> Pauses or resumes the folder's machines. snapshot list <machine> snapshot create <machine> <name> snapshot restore <machine> <name> snapshot delete <machine> <name> Manages a machine's snapshots. show [<machine>] Shows WinQEMU's window, on that machine. help Shows this help.
A machine is named as in WinQEMU's library (case does not matter) or by its id. A folder is named by its path, as list shows it (Linux/Servers). Exit codes: 0 success, 1 failure, 2 incorrect command.

data.name: Cancelled
data.value: Stopped waiting; the machine is left as it is.

data.name: ConnectionLost
data.value: WinQEMU closed the connection without answering.

data.name: NoAnswer
data.value: WinQEMU did not answer within a minute.

data.name: NotPackaged
data.value: WinQEMU is not running, and this command can only start it when run as "winqemu" (the alias installed with WinQEMU).

data.name: AmbiguousMachine
data.value: Several machines are named “{0}”: give its id instead ({1}).

data.name: UnknownMachine
data.value: No machine named “{0}” in the library (winqemu list shows them).

data.name: NoQemu
data.value: WinQEMU does not find QEMU: see its settings.

data.name: StillRunning
data.value: {0} is still running after {1} s; it was not turned off (winqemu poweroff does).

data.name: SnapshotNotPossible
data.value: Not possible for this machine now: its Snapshots section in WinQEMU says why.

data.name: PasswordNeeded
data.value: This machine's disks are encrypted: give the password with --password-stdin, or have WinQEMU remember it.

data.name: UnknownFolder
data.value: No folder “{0}” in the library (winqemu list shows the folders).

data.name: FolderNeedsPassword
data.value: its disks are encrypted and no password is remembered
